_note: Stores literally named `state`/`derived`/`props` still auto-subscribe: upstream only treats $state/$derived/$props as runes when the identifier is a direct child of a call initialising a declarator whose name contains the rune base (processInstanceScriptContent.ts is_rune gate). input.svelte: `$state.count` resolves through the subscription declaration — 0 errors. Bad.svelte: `$state.missing` fires TS2339 against the store's value type, proving the declaration carries the real Writable value type instead of falling through to the ambient rune declaration. DerivedBy.svelte: `const derived = $derived.by(...)` — the `$derived` subscription is declared right after `derived` itself (upstream's `;let $derived = __sveltets_2_store_get(derived);`), so the initializer reads `$derived` before that declaration (TS2448) and the declaration is self-referential (TS7022); both at the same user positions as upstream.
